name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A structured playbook of reusable 'skills' and starting instructions that makes AI coding assistants follow a disciplined, repeatable development process instead of improvising.
buyer: A CTO or engineering lead at a small startup who wants their AI-assisted developers to produce consistent, well-specified code without adding senior reviewers for every PR.
business_use_cases: An engineering consultancy adopts it internally to standardize how every client project uses AI coding agents, then sells that consistency as a pitch differentiator.
A dev-tools educator builds a paid workshop teaching teams how to install and customize the skill set for their own methodology.
A staffing agency offers 'AI-pair-programming ops' services for startups that have no in-house AI tooling expertise.

money_ideas.idea: Paid onboarding workshops helping engineering teams adopt the methodology
A commercial add-on pack of specialized, industry-specific skills sold monthly

steal_this: Package a 90-minute 'set up Superpowers for your team' session and pitch it directly to startup CTOs this weekend.
